reproduction.trigger: Authorization/balancing resumes at elapsed wall or monotonic deadline while timer callbacks remain undispatched; original pipeline returns the submitted identifier.

coverage: Independent wall and monotonic expiry without timer dispatch; backwards wall time does not extend an elapsed monotonic wait
Setup connect/status/configuration/addresses cannot start a later step after expiry
Late authorization/balancing cannot deserialize, checkpoint or submit a balanced transaction
Final authorization after durable checkpoint must recheck deadline before broadcast
Late connector resolve and reject retain unknown outcome and original identifier; no retry
Monotonic 1.5-second wallet discovery when wall time does not advance
Actual Chrome desktop/mobile simulated wall-clock jump during setup and existing IndexedDB quota flow with non-signing/non-broadcasting wallet stubs
Existing timely errors/results, timer cleanup and combined deployment/report regression
limits: No physical suspend/resume, native-wallet signing/broadcast or hard real-time guarantee.
An already invoked wallet broadcast may continue; its result can remain unknown.
Forward wall-clock adjustment can expire a phase conservatively.
Discovery timing refinement is unit-tested; browser cases exercise setup continuation rejection and quota handling.
No full regression or runtime image refresh after this change.
